reference_sql:
SELECT ph.product_id, DATE '2026-01-05' - ph.valid_from AS days_at_price
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Earbuds'
  AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT ph.product_id, DATE '2026-01-05' - MAX(ph.valid_from) AS days_at_price FROM price_history ph JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Earbuds' GROUP BY ph.product_id

SELECT p.product_id, date_diff('day', ph.valid_from, DATE '2026-01-05') AS days_at_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL WHERE c.category_name = 'Earbuds'

other_way.sql: SELECT ph.product_id, DATE '2026-01-05' - MAX(ph.valid_from) AS days_at_price FROM price_history ph JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Earbuds' GROUP BY ph.product_id
other_way.tradeoff: Taking each product's latest valid_from also finds the current price, but it relies on price versions never overlapping.

solver.query:
SELECT p.product_id, DATE '2026-01-05' - CAST(ph.valid_from AS DATE) AS days_at_price
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Earbuds'
  AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
